title: loadCliProgram
responsibility: Builds the root Commander program and loads only the selected command family while keeping full root help available.

inputs.name: loadCliProgram.args
inputs.description: The arguments after the executable name, of which only the first token is read (the second when the first is `help`); that token is matched exactly against a command name or alias, so `g` selects `generate` and `plugin` selects the `module` family. A missing or unmatched token loads no command family, and every `commandHelp` row is then registered only as a help placeholder.

outputs.name: loadCliProgram
outputs.description: The root Commander program named `harness`, with the root description and the version from `sdkPackage` set, and with the selected family's commands registered once its loader resolves. Each `commandHelp` row that is not loaded becomes a help placeholder with only its signature, description and aliases, and `plugin` gets no placeholder when the `module` family is loaded.

errors.name: Selected command registration failure
errors.description: The returned promise rejects when the selected family's loader fails, either because its dynamic `import()` rejects or because its registration call throws; the loader is awaited without a catch, so that rejection reaches the caller. No loader runs when no token matches, so this rejection cannot occur then.
